derivation: exact coe_subset.1 <| by simpa only [coe_mul] using (Set.subset_mul_right (↑t) (by simpa using hs))
explanation: The Set theorem says that a set containing 1, multiplied on the left by any set, contains that set. Applying it to the coercions of the finsets and using `coe_mul` and `coe_subset` yields the target. The existing proof instead constructs membership directly with `mem_mul`.
